Union-find (disjoint set union): groups that merge

Union-find keeps track of which items are in the same group while groups keep merging, and answers "are these two together?" in practically constant time. This page builds it from a parent array, adds the two optimisations that make it fast (path compression and union by rank), and then uses one reusable template for Redundant Connection, Accounts Merge, Number of Islands II and Making a Large Island, plus the variants interviewers reach for next.
